funds_data.description: The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) in a portfolio of equity investments in issuers economically tied to India. Equity investments include common stocks, preferred stocks, American depositary receipts (“ADRs”) and global depositary receipts (“GDRs”) of all market capitalizations. The fund is non-diversified.
